_comment: The guide's GCC and licensing table (its 'GCC and licensing, feature by feature' section, as of November 11, 2026), one row per feature, with the interim path the kit expects where GCC availability is 'not yet specified'. Learn states availability for the product only: 'Global Secure Access is available in the US Government Community Cloud (GCC)' (Known limitations for Global Secure Access). Generally available features rest on that sentence; preview features are not yet specified. Re-read the limitations page before each ring and update readOn. Microsoft 365 GCC (Moderate) only.

features.name: Client on Microsoft Entra registered devices (Private Access only)
features.interim: Deploy the client to Microsoft Entra joined or hybrid joined devices only.

features.name: Microsoft traffic profile; source IP restoration
Internet Access: web content filtering, threat intelligence, security profiles
features.license: Internet Access or Microsoft Entra Suite

features.name: Internet Access: cloud firewall for clients
features.interim: Block QUIC (outbound UDP 443) with an Intune-delivered Windows Firewall rule, piloted first (the guide's Step 5.6); record it in the architecture record's quicBlock.

features.name: Internet Access: Explicit Forward Proxy
features.interim: Acquire traffic with the client only; where a PAC file stays, exclude every FQDN and IP the client tunnels (the guide's Step 11.2).

features.name: Internet Access: source traffic type and HTTP method filtering
features.interim: Filter by web category and FQDN in security profiles (generally available).

features.name: Private Access: Quick Access, per-app access, private DNS, application discovery
Custom Private Access profiles
features.interim: Per-app applications, each with its own group assignment and Conditional Access, in the one Private Access profile.

features.name: Compliant network check
features.license: Included in P1 or P2 (Microsoft traffic profile)

features.name: Universal tenant restrictions
features.license: Included in P1 or P2 (Microsoft traffic profile)

features.name: TLS inspection, Microsoft-managed or agency certificate
Private Access sensor on domain controllers
Remote networks (branch IPsec)
features.license: At least 50 P1 and Internet Access licenses combined

features.name: Traffic logs and the NetworkAccessTrafficLogs category
features.note: The traffic logs page is titled '(preview)'.

features.name: EnrichedOffice365AuditLogs and NetworkAccessGenerativeAIInsights categories
features.interim: Not exported; add only by a decision record (the guide's Step 12.1).

features.name: Intelligent Local Access
features.interim: Not adopted: a Zero Trust Assessment test against it is recorded as not applicable, with the decision record as its exception evidence.

features.name: AI gateway prompt injection protection
features.interim: Not adopted: recorded as not applicable, with the decision record as its exception evidence.

features.name: Microsoft Graph network access API
features.license: As for the feature it configures
features.note: Usable from GCC on graph.microsoft.com; beta, so the kit runs it interactively, in a delegated session, never unattended.
